title: Fixed hand position and narrow hand span
learner: Luca plays comfortably up to 84 bpm. He can read notes from C4 to G5 and has mastered quarter notes and half notes.

needs.description: His hand does not move on the keyboard: all notes stay under the five fingers, from C4 to G4.
His right hand opens comfortably up to a perfect fifth (7 semitones).

intent: The teacher asks for an 8-bar exercise in C major, 4/4, at 72 bpm, that practises pairs of eighth notes.
expectation: Although Luca can read up to G5, every note should stay between C4 and G4, with no leap wider than a fifth.
